records.sourceFile: Effects of rehabilitation interventions on time to return to play and reinjury rate in athletes with acute hamstring strain injuries.pdf

sourceVerification.doiVerification: DOI printed in the local PDF text.

records.evidenceSummary: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 randomized controlled trials (693 athletes) with acute hamstring strain, searched to January 2026 and graded with RoB 2 and GRADE. Two trials of a lengthening-focused protocol (L-protocol) showed a weighted mean difference of -28.29 days to return to play (95% CI -41.60 to -14.99; moderate certainty), with a non-significant re-injury difference (0/65 vs 3/66 events). Two progressive agility and trunk stabilization (PATS) trials showed no significant return-to-play difference and an inconclusive re-injury estimate (RD -0.35, 95% CI -0.74 to 0.03; 2/29 vs 10/24 events), while three platelet-rich plasma (PRP) trials gave a pooled WMD of -6.77 days (95% CI -10.79 to -2.75; I2 = 70%) with no significant re-injury difference.
records.limitations: Most outcomes rest on two or three trials, and GRADE certainty is low or very low for most estimates, so the re-injury results are inconclusive. The review also notes that return-to-play definitions varied and that the search was completed before the PROSPERO registration (May 2026), with screening starting after registration.
records.synthesisCaution: Staff could read the PATS re-injury estimate (RD -0.35) as a 35% absolute reduction, or the PRP and rESWT single-trial results as settled, when each rests on two or three small trials with inconclusive or low-certainty evidence.

changes: findings: pain-threshold strength result was worded as a within-group 15% increase -> between-group mean difference 15% (95% CI 1 to 28%) versus pain-free rehabilitation.
limitations: added two internal conflicts: PRP I2 70% (Results) vs 62% (GRADE text); mean age range 20.3 to 46.6 years vs Table 2 means of about 20 to 30 years.
verification.residualConcerns: Population level is mixed (elite, professional, semi-professional, amateur); both Professional / Elite and Adult / Recreational tags kept. PRP pooled WMD (-6.77 days) is below the authors' 7-day MCID, which supports the low-certainty reading.
